title: Through the Love of God Our Savior
lyrics_original: Through the love of God our Savior,
Free and changeless is His favor;
Precious is the blood that healed us;
Perfect is the grace that sealed us;
Strong the hand stretched out to shield us;
Ours is such a full salvation;
Faith can sing through days of sorrow,
Or in living, or in dying,

bible_verses.english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is a shield and a buckler.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for Your free and changeless favor that holds me secure through every storm. When life feels overwhelming, remind me of the precious blood of Jesus that healed me and the strong hand that shields me. Help me to trust that because I am Yours, all is well and all will be well. I place my fears into Your loving hands today. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for Your free and changeless favor that holds me secure through every storm. devotional.reflection_english: In the midst of life’s trials and uncertainties, this hymn grounds our hearts in the unwavering truth of God's love. Because Christ’s grace has sealed us and His hand protects us, we can rest deeply in the promise that all will be well. Tribulation may surround us, but it cannot sever us from the eternal salvation won by Jesus. As you sing, surrender your anxieties and let His changeless favor quiet every fear in your soul.
